title: Designing Agentic AI-Based Screening for Portfolio Investment
central_strategy: A fundamental-rule LLM agent and a news-sentiment FinBERT agent screen the S&P 500 monthly, using intersection with union/default fallback. Candidate assets then enter high-dimensional precision-matrix estimation and GMV, 1%-monthly-target minimum-variance, or maximum-Sharpe portfolio optimization with a 180-month formation window and 10 bp costs.

required_but_missing: Point-in-time S&P 500 membership/identifiers and exact CRSP/Compustat, IBES/WRDS, factor, and news-to-security snapshots.
The FinBERT checkpoint/revision, tokenizer/inference settings, monthly probabilities, and sentiment signal ledger.
All annual LLM-S prompts, injected cross-sections/tool payloads, exact model snapshots/settings, responses, and buy/sell/hold rules.
Dated ensemble sets/fallback events and the full precision-estimator, optimizer, solver, deep-model, and seed configuration.
Fitted matrices, weights, returns, turnover, costs, paired-test samples, rerun outputs, and table-generating arrays.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_one_date_prompt_is_insufficient: The December-2023 listing supplies only one 2024 rule. It cannot identify the annual LLM-S rules for the medium and short windows or any dated monthly selection set.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_finbert_only_is_not_the_headline: FinBERT is one screening agent and a fallback/robustness component. A replacement FinBERT-only portfolio would omit the paper's agentic fundamental rule, ensemble intersection/fallback, and exact selected universe.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_linked_news_does_not_close_the_gap: The 4,589-row news file has text/symbol/date inputs but no paper sentiment scores or checkpoint lineage, and it does not supply the missing fundamental/IBES screen or portfolio outputs.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_independent_code_is_not_a_replicatio: The unaffiliated repository replaces Gemini with Claude, FinBERT with a custom LLM, five precision estimators with PyPortfolioOpt, the 180-month window with 60/24 months, and the paper data with current SEC/Yahoo inputs.

closure_rule: Do not promote the linked news file, one-date prompt, FinBERT-only substitute, logistic/Novy-Marx baseline, or unaffiliated rewrite to the paper's agentic screen. Reopen for author signal ledgers/runtime or a complete causal release.
